name: The Secret Prison
summary: Sully asks you to enter Alcaz Prison and learn what became of the King of Stormwind. The king’s fate bears heavily on Stormwind.

sections.title: A Search at Alcaz
sections.body: Sully sends you to Alcaz, an outpost thought to be abandoned since the Third War. No one he knows has spoken of a prison there. Yet there may be a chance the King of Stormwind is inside, and Sully needs you to learn what became of him.

sections.title: What You Find
sections.body: At Alcaz Prison, you learn that the King of Stormwind is dead. You also discover that a greater force is pulling the strings behind the lesser dragon you slew. Sully must hear what you have learned.

faq.answer: Sully sends you to Alcaz Prison, at an outpost thought to be abandoned since the Third War.

faq.q: What does Sully want me to learn?
faq.answer: Sully wants you to learn what became of the King of Stormwind.

faq.q: What is Alcaz believed to be?
faq.answer: Alcaz is thought to be an abandoned outpost from the Third War.

faq.q: Why does Sully send me to Alcaz?
faq.answer: Sully sends you because there may be a chance the King of Stormwind is there.
